4325: Rowan County park on 10-acre Lake Murtis, with every site in the woods, some of them on the fishing lake; all but 3 have electric and water. --Claude
4331: City of High Point campground on Oak Hollow Lake in the 1,550-acre Oak Hollow Park, gated; 103 full-hookup RV sites, most with cable TV, and 13 tent platforms. --Claude
4362: Private campground at I-95 exit 193 near Dillon, with a 7-acre stocked fishing lake and a dog park; every site is a pull-through, 43 of them with full hookups. --Claude
4366: Private RV park a mile off I-20 exit 22, 10 minutes from downtown Aiken, with a playground; 47 sites have full hookups and 9 are pull-throughs, and it rents by the month as well as the night. --Claude
4369: Private campground near Winnsboro, about 20 minutes from Columbia, with RV loops on both sides of SC-215, very large pads, many of them shaded by hardwoods, nature trails and a dog park.  It also rents by the month, and pitches itself to workers at the V.C. Summer nuclear plant 6 miles north. --Claude
4376: Private campground near Table Rock State Park in the Blue Ridge foothills, with a small creek running through it, RV and tent sites, and a laundry open around the clock. --Claude
4377: RV park on 30 acres about 4 miles from Clemson and Seneca and half a mile from Lake Hartwell access, with concrete pads, mountain views, a clubhouse and trails; no membership is needed despite the name.  Its Economy sites go by the week or month, with student rates and football-season passes; the Deluxe sites are the ones sold by the night. --Claude
4378: York County park on Lake Wylie, with 33 paved full-hookup RV sites and 16 primitive tent sites. --Claude
4380: York County park on Lake Wylie north of Rock Hill, with 79 full-hookup RV sites and 5 tent sites. --Claude
4444: Rebuilt campground below Pickwick Dam on TVA land, run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee (Vista Recreation): about 92 sites with electric and water in three loops, 8 or 9 primitive tent sites and three bathhouses. --Claude
4445: Campground on the south shore of Normandy Lake (TVA land), run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee, with gravel sites, a swimming beach, a boat ramp, a bathhouse and a pavilion. --Claude
4446: Campground on Normandy Lake (TVA land) near Manchester, run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee and separate from Barton Springs on the same lake, with a swimming beach, a boat ramp and a pavilion; 45 sites have water and electric and 8 are primitive. --Claude
4448: TVA campground on Watts Bar Lake run by the concessionaire Tennessee Valley Hospitality (Go Camp Tennessee), with big-rig-friendly gravel sites, a boat ramp, a swimming area and a bathhouse. --Claude
4450: TVA campground at Melton Hill Dam on the Clinch River, run by the concessionaire Tennessee Valley Hospitality (Go Camp Tennessee), big-rig friendly, with a boat ramp and bathhouses: 9 full-hookup sites, 35 with electric and water, and 15 for tents with no hookups. --Claude
4451: Campground below Douglas Dam on the French Broad River, run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee with TVA, with a boat ramp and a fishing pier; about 60 sites with electric and water, plus a few primitive tent sites. --Claude
4452: Campground above Douglas Dam on Douglas Lake, run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee with TVA, with a swimming beach, a boat ramp, a picnic area and three bathhouses; 54 sites have electric and water, and 4 are primitive tent sites. --Claude
4453: TVA campground on the south side of Cherokee Dam, run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee (Vista Recreation): 39 sites with electric and water and 5 primitive.  The perimeter and waterfront sites are the roomiest. --Claude
4454: TVA campground on Norris Lake run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee (Vista Recreation), with a swimming beach and three cabins; 59 of its 64 or 65 sites have electric.  The interior roads are paved, but a reviewer found the approach road tight. --Claude
4455: TVA campground on the Watauga River below Watauga Dam, run by the concessionaire Tennessee Valley Hospitality (Go Camp Tennessee); every site has electric and water, 3 have sewer too, and there are no tent sites. --Claude
4477: Long-established RV resort on 200 acres of the Cumberland Plateau at Crossville, with oversized big-rig sites, a pool, a dog park and the private 25-acre Good Neighbor Lake for fishing and swimming from a beach. --Claude
4489: Private RV park on Kentucky Lake at Buchanan. --Claude
4490: Private RV park along the Cumberland River at Granville, near Cordell Hull Lake, with walking trails, a playground and an on-site pizza restaurant; big-rig friendly. --Claude
4491: Private RV park with cabins at Jamestown on the Cumberland Plateau, renting by the night, week or month. --Claude
4504: Campground on an island in Chickamauga Lake on TVA land, run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee (Vista Recreation), with a beach. --Claude
4505: Private RV park in Wears Valley on US 321, between Sevierville and Townsend. --Claude
